title: The 'cost-of-living squeeze' mediates survival in a desert ectotherm

yaml.title: The 'cost-of-living squeeze' mediates survival in a desert ectotherm

markdown.markdown:
Welcome to the analytical and computational documentation for our study investigating how thermal environment and energetic demands—the **cost-of-living squeeze (COLS)**—influence the survival and spatial ecology of western fence lizards (*Sceloporus occidentalis*) across elevation gradients.

This repository is structured as a reproducible research website containing the complete workflows, statistical analyses, spatial models, and biophysical simulations supporting the manuscript.

---


Each document in this repository addresses a specific component of the study:

- [**Home Range Estimation**](home-range-estimation.qmd): Processes mark-recapture data, evaluates capture saturation and sampling completeness across field seasons, estimates empirical inter-annual survival rates, and delineates individual Minimum Convex Polygon (MCP) home ranges across high- and low-elevation populations.

- [**Resting Metabolic Rates**](resting-metabolic-rates.qmd): Analyzes resting metabolic rates (RMR) across temperatures, body sizes, and populations to parameterize temperature-dependent energetic expenditure functions.

- [**Behavioral Thermoregulation Simulations**](simulations-behavioral-thermoregulation.qmd): Implements biophysical and behavioral thermoregulation simulations to model operative environmental temperatures, activity windows, and thermoregulatory costs under current and projected thermal landscapes.

- [**COLS as Feeding Demand**](feeding-demand.qmd): Translates thermal and metabolic costs into daily and seasonal feeding demands, quantifying the intensity of the cost-of-living squeeze experienced by individuals.

- [**Effects of COLS on Survival**](cols-survival.qmd): Tests the direct and interactive effects of metabolic feeding demands (COLS) on individual survival probabilities and population demographic rates.


---

## Datasets Included

The repository includes raw and processed data stored within the [data](data) directory:

- [data/mr_data.rds](data/mr_data.rds)  
  The compiled longitudinal mark-recapture dataset. Contains individual identities (`id`), capture dates (`year`, `doy`), sex, morphometric traits (snout-vent length `svl`, mass), and geographic coordinates (`lat`, `lon`, `utm_x`, `utm_y`).

- [data/home_ranges.rds](data/home_ranges.rds)  
  Derived spatial polygon vertices computed via convex hulls (`chull`) for individuals with $\ge 4$ relocations after removing spatial outlier records ($> 150\text{ m}$ from individual centroids). Used for comparative spatial extent analysis across elevations.

- [data/respirometry.rds](data/respirometry.rds)  
  Respirometry data containing resting metabolic rate measurements across temperatures, body sizes, and populations. Used to parameterize temperature-dependent energetic expenditure functions.
